items.textToSpeech: Population Reference Intakes are a type of Dietary Reference Value established by the European Food Safety Authority for the European Union population. Recommended Dietary Intakes are a type of Nutrient Reference Value established by the National Health and Medical Research Council for the Australia and New Zealand population.
Both terms refer to a level of daily nutrient intake that will meet the requirements of 97.5% of the individuals in the population. Is there anything else I can help you with?
